services.name: Bell Tent Rental
services.desc: ABOUT: "Rent The Tent"-The Bell Tent is great for those who have larger groups....the tent will hold 6-8 sleeping bags comfortably. Just let us know where you want the tent and we will set it up and pick up! You can choose a special location, but don't forget about the fun of camping in your own backyard. The bell tent is so cool, and great for special occasions. Whether it be for camping birthday parties, bride or groom holding area for weddings, or a dinner party with a cocktail area... the tent will be the perfect addition to make your occasion special! services.name: Lea Island Nature Adventure
services.desc: About An amazing day-trip to our "nature lovers" PARADISE! Lea Island is a four-mile uninhabited island located between Figure Eight and Topsail Islands. The special island has been designated as one of 96 Important Bird Areas in North Carolina and is a refuge for many types of shorebirds and waterbirds, as well as nesting loggerhead sea turtles. Lea Island is known by the locals as "the place to go" for dropping anchor and combing the white sand beaches for shells, including sand dollars and whelks. Nature at it's finest, and just a 25 minute boat ride from Wrightsville Beach...Lea Island is simply beautiful! Make sure to bring along a bucket for shells! Duration 3

services.desc: Half Day Private Charters - With a Private Boat Charter, you get a completely private boating trip with one of our USCG licensed captains, who are knowledgeable in our local "hot spots", diverse wildlife and local history. Relax and enjoy your surroundings while one of our captains chauffeurs you and your group to one of the favorite local paradises that can only be accessed by boat, like Masonboro Island, Mason's Inlet or Lee Island. IT'S YOUR CRUISE SO YOU CHOOSE...You’ll have plenty of activity options to choose from, including island hopping, backwater boating, dolphin watching, beach-combing and more. services.name: Steam Pot Seafood Boil Experience
services.desc: Cruise over to one of our favorite islands to cook up a low country boil steam pot fromTopsail Steamer out of Wrightsville Beach! Relax on the island and take in the beautiful scenery while your captain cooks your steam pot to perfection! We provide the steam pot burner for cooking and a table for the food. YOUR CAPTAIN COOKS THE FOOD! Most of our customers prefer to stand around the table to eat, but feel free to bring plates if you prefer to make a plate and eat in your beach chair! Great for families, couples, or party groups! Please Note Steam Pot sold separately, delivered to our boat, and cooked by your captain. services.name: Masonboro Island Adventure
services.desc: About Board our 24ft. Carolina Skiff and come with us to see why everyone loves beautiful Masonboro Island…One of the largest undisturbed barrier islands along the southern part of the NC coast. As we cruise on a 15-20 minute boat ride over to the island, the captain will discuss and point out native wildlife, local history, and the diverse eco-systems surrounding our coastline. Once you arrive on the island, you will have about an hour to explore the beach, and comb the island for shells. After exploring the island you will board the boat and enjoy the scenic views as we make our way back to the dock. Bring your camera for this trip! services.name: Chef Dinner Experience with True Blue Butcher & Table (Please call to book!)
services.desc: Duration 3 Hours About Come aboard and cruise with Epic Excursions to an uninhabited island where a culinary experience awaits with everyone's favorite restaurant team, True Blue Butcher & Table! Experience panoramic views of water and nature as one of the True Blue chefs prepares an amazing dinner on an open fire. The True Blue team has put together an amazing menu for an unforgettable beachside dining experience. If the chef experience is not in your budget, we now offer a "drop off" menu from True Blue. The meal is be prepared at the restaurant and delivered to our boat in warming plates for your excursion. Menu Options Are Available On The Website The length of the experience is 3 hours

services.name: Oyster Farm Tour & Tasting
services.desc: About Come aboard and join us for the full experience of visiting a local oyster farm and sampling freshly shucked oysters harvested by Middle Sound Mariculture while surrounded by the natural beauty of Masonboro Island. This Epic tour will include a sampling of raw and steamed oysters with a complimentary wine selection, but feel free to bring along any other beverage of choice. Hosted by Middle Sound Mariculture and Epic Excursions. Your tour starts with a guided boat ride aboard our 24ft Carolina Skiff, the Epic Explorer, to the Middle Sound Mariculture Farm where you will learn how these delicious oysters are raised from seed to harvest. Bring your own board or let us provide our custom built boards, by our own renowned shaper, Ian Balding. Climb aboard and relax while your captain takes you over to the best spots to catch the best waves on tap for the day. services.name: Salt Marsh Paddleboarding Tour
services.desc: Explore the natural salt marshes and uninhabited islands surrounding Wrightsville Beach with our Epic Excursions guided paddleboarding tours. Our tours are special, as you will paddle through serene areas that are secluded and swarming with nature. An experienced guide will lead you through the calm waterways filled with a variety of wildlife, allowing you to fully immerse yourself into the natural habitat surrounding Wrightsville Beach. It's the perfect tour to unwind and get away from the crowded beaches and boat traffic, as you experience the beauty of Wrightsville Beach's coastal ecosystem. A MUST DO IF YOU WANT TO EXPERIENCE SOMETHING
